signature.name: Qilou Old Street
signature.detail: Haikou's most famous sight is a long arcade of early-20th-century shophouses with ornate facades, best explored on foot in the late afternoon when the light softens and the arcades fill with local life. Go early morning or after sunset to avoid the midday heat, and wear comfortable shoes since the street stretches for well over a kilometre.

signature.name: Haikou Century Bridge
signature.detail: This cable-stayed bridge over the mouth of the Haikou River is the city's modern icon and a fine spot for sunset views and an evening stroll. Come around dusk for the best light and cooler air; it is free to walk across.

signature.name: Qiongzhou Strait
signature.detail: The strait separating Hainan from the mainland defines Haikou's setting, and the waterfront is the place to feel the sea breeze and watch ferries cross. Visit in the early morning or evening for comfortable temperatures, and bring sun protection during the day.
